Theorem
[estimates for curvature] Source: kleiner-lott 1. Theorem A.3\group Kleiner–Lott Analytic Appendices

Let $(M,g(\cdot ))$ be a complete Ricci flow solution on $[0,T]$ with uniformly bounded curvature. If $u=u(x,t)\in W^{1,2}_{loc}$ weakly satisfies $\frac{\partial u}{\partial t}\leq \triangle _{g(t)}u$, has $u(\cdot ,0)\leq 0$, and, for some $c>0$, \begin{equation} \int _0^T\int _M e^{-\: c\: d_t^2(x,x_0)}u^2(x,s)\: dV(x)\: ds<\infty , \end{equation} then $u(\cdot ,t)\leq 0$ for all $t\in [0,T]$.
